body: Lesson for E2 (w-8f4c) hostless runs (Opus2, 2026-11-07 05:45Z): the Engram source producer (54a) refuses when its scratch (TEMP/TMP) lies INSIDE the tree it inspects: 'ENGRAM_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE / input_unavailable: source EOL scratch is inside the inspected tree'. Put the private HOME/USERPROFILE/TEMP/TMP/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA/PSModuleAnalysisCachePath in a SIBLING directory outside the inspected worktree but inside the repository, e.g. Windows B .tmp/j/<id>-env or DL560 .tmp/r/<id>-s. Never place them in the worktree's own .tmp. This applies to E2's Windows FULL dispatch too.
